## Introduction and Qualitative Purpose

This chapter transfers the framework into biomechanics and robotics, where coupling, constraints, and contact make purely heuristic tuning fragile.

## In Laymans Terms

For complex systems, we need controllers that stay reliable when everything is coupled.

## Geometric Intuition

Metrics reshape local error geometry so the controller can prioritize directions that matter for outcome quality and robustness.

## Mechanical Backbone

$$
H(q)\ddot q + C(q,\dot q)\dot q + g(q)=\tau+J_c(q)^\top\lambda.
$$

The tangent model around this dynamics is the bridge to both contraction and local optimal-control design.
